title: Lower Player End Gravity
description: This mod makes so the players gravity is lower in the End.
body:
![LOWER END GRAVITY](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/61eedb98dc79c4553394f54d8a649d73c089a153.png)

BTW FIXED VERSION ON CURSEFORGE

This mod will lower the End's gravity by a bit but it only applies to the PLAYER!
So items dropped will drop normally, or other gravity related stuff will be normal.

This mod makes fighting the dragon and exploring the end much more fun!
You can jump around 3 blocks high up in the end.
